sources.scope: Selected kernel entry/workspace/stream contracts and distribution boundary; source-only, no execution
Complete 21-page paper and appendices: controlled comparison, independent correctness, repair/coverage and timing evidence; author-reported, no PDF/figure redistribution
Selected CPU observation-to-action benchmark, client/profiler/aggregation and author artifact contracts; source-derived methodology, not native execution or quality/performance acceptance
Independently normalized VLA metric semantics; predates the later SmolVLA experiment

applicability.scope: Selecting task quality gates, reference parity checks and performance workloads for text, agentic coding, work agents, cache-aware ASR, TTS, full-duplex audio/video, image and video inference, and designing goodput-based multi-regime comparisons that fit InferRSI's evidence trail; interpreting treatment delivery, arm validity and stated-versus-observed protocol enforcement in supplied tuning reports; designing or auditing VLA deployment comparisons with explicit observation-to-action boundaries, generated/replayed horizons, per-task quality and source/precision identity
applicability.prerequisites: The primary objective, timing boundary, quality gates, sample/failure accounting, required regimes, repetitions, seeds and decision rule are frozen before optimization; baseline and candidate share hardware, software stack, input distribution, benchmark configuration, warmup and measurement protocol, and on a shared machine also one time window and dedicated devices; cache-aware ASR also requires the selected model/config and first/steady geometry, decoded clock and reset/EOU/EOF boundaries to be established; VLA comparisons also freeze generated/replayed horizons, initial-state/noise protocol and intended precision or quantization treatment
applicability.input_contract: The task family and deployment use case; candidate quality evaluators and reference parity; the declared SLO and the caller's policy on which regimes must improve or must not regress; for an audit, a supplied fixed-workload report with request-to-trial grouping, exclusion and failure counts and the declared aggregation rule; for a treatment audit, the frozen delivery/arm-validity rules, run/candidate identities, feedback and consumer-input evidence, and per-arm raw records; for VLA audits, the declared CPU input/output boundary, source/fixture/checkpoint/processor identities, per-task trial scope and available raw records or explicit artifact gaps
applicability.produced_artifact: A frozen benchmark design with evaluators, reference parity, primary objective, timing boundary, quality gates, required regimes, repetition and seed rules and an explicit decision config, plus the evidence-tree layout a PASS claim must produce; for a supplied report, the computed threshold result and missing evidence. Candidate knowledge, not qualification of any model or backend; for a treatment audit, a contract-bound eligibility and interpretation report separating treatment exposure, observed checks, comparator identity, anomaly disposition and source conflicts; for VLA reports, a timing/denominator and precision reconciliation with per-task quality/completion accounting and source-artifact limits
failure_modes: Raw throughput is optimized in place of goodput, so requests served outside the SLO count toward a win
One concurrency level or one undisclosed aggregate score stands in for all required regimes
Recorded agent task scores or replay completion are read as current task success, or a VBench prompt workload as computed VBench quality
An upstream better/worse/inconclusive label is used as InferRSI's PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE verdict
Runs on the same hardware class, in different time windows or on shared devices are compared as if pinned
A quality pass is taken to certify that the timed work actually occurred
Best-seen results are reported as delivered without restarting and validating the final code/config artifact
A cache-aware ASR EOU is treated as EOF or full reset, nominal chunk duration as the decoded mel frontier, or shape-only geometry PASS as a native model-state test
An enabled treatment or stored feedback summary is taken as proof of delivery to the next eligible consumer
A failed arm-validity condition is overridden by a favorable best timing or a saturation/null interpretation
Complete gate keys or zero recorded failures are read as proof that every declared protocol check ran
Generated-action amortization is read as action-response latency or actual control frequency
Matching structural pair fields are taken to certify matched effective compute precision or quality equivalence
An aggregate VLA success rate conceals task-specific losses or missing/skipped episodes
A public current script, recorded experiment revision or binary hash is treated as the exact measured dirty source patch
Whole-device fallback memory is relabelled as process-attributed memory or compared with simulator-inclusive/allocator quantities
applicability.refusal_point: Records missing coverage and high-variance results as INCONCLUSIVE rather than a win; a run without a frozen RunSpec, or whose validator changed after the plan was frozen, is INCONCLUSIVE regardless of metric values; sets no universal numeric gate or noise threshold; withholds causal treatment benefit/null conclusions when required delivery or arm eligibility is unverified, and preserves conflicts between stated protocol, exported code and source reports; withholds VLA quality-preservation, runtime-only attribution, control-rate or current-build conclusions when their required precision, per-task, timestamp or measured-source evidence is missing

recommendations: Freeze one primary objective, timing boundary, quality gates and sample/failure accounting before optimization.
Choose the required regimes from the deployment use case, report each separately, and record which must improve or must not regress in a versioned decision config.
Use the replay trace that matches the actual deployment pattern.
State the concurrency, trace, model, SKU and microbenchmark scope boundaries in any report that cites benchmark results.
Trace treatment to its eligible consumer and apply the frozen arm-validity precedence before attributing benefit, saturation or a null.
Separate complete VLA request cost, generated/replayed action denominators and actual control cadence; retain per-task quality and measured-source/precision limits.
limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.
Task benchmark knowledge is distilled from issue #60 with selected pinned-source rechecks; no all-task runtime qualification or optimization benefit is established.
Benchmark feasibility and package-consumption checks do not promote this candidate or replace task quality, repeated A/B and service qualification.

The pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp ASR reference covers selected source/test definitions and author-reported benchmark boundaries; native model/device, decoder internals, quality, long-audio/load and service behavior remain not_run.

JustGoal contributes source-only controlled-evaluation and kernel-acceptance guidance; its repaired/retested timings, released-pass counts and protocol differences are author-reported, not locally reproduced or a complete campaign runner.

The AutoTuneBench reference is source-only: original operational checkpoint/prompt receipts remain unavailable, source contradictions remain explicit, and no tuning, device/performance or agent-efficacy validation was run.

The Embodied.cpp reference is source-derived: its public latency arrays allow arithmetic audit, but raw episode recount, exact measured script/dirty patch, effective dispatch and current model/device/service or efficacy qualification remain unresolved.
